auth.panelTitle: Scanned once. Everyone who matters knows.
auth.panelBody: Your family's emergency details, ready on a wallet card, a helmet sticker or a lock screen.
auth.trust1: You choose every detail that's shown
auth.trust2: Your family gets a text the moment it's scanned
auth.trust3: No app needed for the person helping
auth.phoneSubtitle: We'll text you a 6-digit code. No passwords, ever.
auth.phoneHint: New here? The same code creates your account.
auth.emailSubtitle: We'll email you a 6-digit code. No passwords, ever.
auth.demoCodeHint: Demo mode: any 6 digits will work.
auth.welcomeSubtitle: Anyone who looks after a profile with you will see this name.
auth.errorInvalidCode: That code didn't work. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.errorRateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
auth.errorDisallowedCountry: We can't send codes to that country yet.
auth.errorSriLankaMobile: Use a mobile number starting with 07 — landlines can't get texts.
auth.errorEmail: Check the email address — it doesn't look complete.
auth.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
